name: Rho GTPase activating protein 28

function.text: ARHGAP28 is the approved symbol for Rho GTPase activating protein 28. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in GTPase activator activity; negative regulation of stress fiber assembly; regulation of actin filament polymerization.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Esophageal carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
